monotheism.definition: n. belief in a single God

monotheists.definition:

monothelite.definition:
n. One of an ancient sect who held that Christ had but
   one will as he had but one nature. Cf. Monophysite.
monothelite.translation: n. 一志论派(基督教的一个派别,认为基督虽具有神、 人两性,但只有一个意志和作用,即神的意志和作用)

monothetic.translation: 单生的, 单一生成的

monotocous.definition:

monotone.definition:
n. an unchanging intonation

a. 单调的
